title: OM p2 tail crossover
objective: Profile and source-transparently accelerate the complete vector429 p2 OM local certificate to a measured Sage.js crossover while preserving exact arbitrary residual-field mathematics and dynamic fallbacks
references: Guàrdia, Montes, and Nart, Higher Newton polygons and integral bases

handoff.summary: Removed recursive prior-key valuation replay from the general MacLane evaluator and added a source-transparent bounded-batch exact HNF kernel for mixed higher-quotient lattices. On vector429 p=2 this reduced type-tree construction from about 8.5s to 3.7s and quotient/HNF selection from over 30s to about 1.2s. The complete rebased Sage.js certificate is exact (index valuation 332, certificate om2-9a0211b708df7354), matches CPython and the frozen local HNF, and rejects deliberate corruption. A bounded current sample took 10.197s versus current Round-2 at 6.129s, so no p=2 auto-eligibility was added.
risks: The complete p=2 OM path remains slower than current Round-2 and must stay fail-closed for automatic selection.
The integration lane must register packed_incremental_row_hnf_in_place in architecture/native-kernels.json and add the focused test/benchmark to shared manifests without overlapping this lane.
next_steps: Integrate the native-kernel registry and test-manifest hooks, then rerun architecture:check and the native suite.
Only widen the OM selector if a later complete exact end-to-end measurement is stably below the active Round-2 comparator.
